entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. This is absolutely unacceptable. I want to return these garbage cycling shoes I bought from you.

I can certainly look into that for you, and I do apologize for the wait time. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Are you kidding me? They're defective! They're painful! They gave me the worst blisters I've ever had. I can't even get the cleats adjusted properly. I've been cycling for over a decade, I know how shoes are supposed to fit. These are just poorly made.
I'm very sorry to hear the shoes caused you blisters. That's definitely not the quality we aim for at VeloFit. Do you have your order number handy so I can pull up the details?

Yes, it's VF88602. And don't give me the runaround. I want a full refund, not some store credit nonsense. If you can't do that, get me your manager right now. I'm one click away from plastering this all over social media.
I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. Let me just review your order. Okay, I see you purchased the cycling shoes 61 days ago. Let me just double-check our policy.
Alright, thank you for your patience. It looks like you're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh. It's... it's 90 days? Well, alright then. That's what it should be. So how do I get the refund?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account right now. You just need to package the shoes, attach the label, and drop the box at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Okay. Fine. Make sure that email comes through.
It has just been sent. You should see it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
